data.one_liner: Animate widgets into a visible state with opacity, scale, position, and angle.
data.what_it_does: The Entry widget allows you to easily animate a widget into a visible state. It simultaneously handles opacity, scale, position, and angle transitions using a single wrapper widget.
use_when: You want to animate widgets when they first appear on screen.
You want to create staggered grid animations or simple entry effects easily.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based gesture-driven animations.
You are building non-widget animations or custom game rendering loops.
strengths: Animates multiple properties (opacity, scale, position, angle) concurrently.
Includes helpful named constructors like Entry.all, Entry.opacity, and Entry.offset.
weaknesses: Relies on the external simple_animations package.
Limited to entry/appearance animation use cases.
data.minimal_example:
Entry(
  opacity: 0,
  xOffset: -100,
  child: Text("Hello World"),
)
